Interface FileWatcher.WatchRequest

Enclosing interface:
FileWatcher
public static interface FileWatcher.WatchRequest
A request to watch a directory, completed by watch(Consumer) or watchAsync(Function).

Patterns are JDK glob patterns matched against the path of a change relative to the root. A pattern that starts with **/ needs a separator, so it does not match a file directly under the root: {**/,}*.html matches every HTML file, **/*.html only those in a subdirectory.

Each terminal operation takes a snapshot of the request, so a request may be reused, and changed, for further registrations.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

      FileWatcher.WatchRequest recursive(boolean recursive)
      Whether directories below the root are watched too, including directories created later. Hidden directories are never watched. Defaults to true.
      Parameters:
      recursive - Whether to watch the whole tree

      This request

    • exclude

      FileWatcher.WatchRequest exclude(String... globs)
      Adds patterns a changed path must not match to be delivered. A directory is not watched at all when an exclude pattern excludes everything below it, as build/** does for build; a pattern such as build/*, which excludes only the direct children of build, leaves the directories below them watched.
      Parameters:
      globs - Glob patterns relative to the root, for example build/**
      Returns:
      This request

    • watchAsync

      FileWatcherRegistration watchAsync(Function<? super FileChangeBatch, ? extends CompletionStage<?>> listener)
      Registers a listener whose work completes with the stage it returns. The registration receives no further batch until the stage completed; the changes that arrive meanwhile are merged into the next batch.

      The directories are registered before the method returns. It is named apart from watch(Consumer) so that a lambda such as batch -> restart(batch) is not ambiguous between the two.

      Parameters:
      listener - The listener, invoked with each batch of changes under the root
      Returns:
      The registration, which the caller closes when it is no longer interested
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the root does not exist or is not a directory
      UncheckedIOException - if the directories cannot be registered
